main.name: Sam Ayoub
main.description: AI/ML Architecture Director & Engineering Team Lead / Big Data & ML Training Systems / Software Migration & Integration Architect
main.bio: Engineering leader and principal architect directing cross-functional teams and technical strategy for AI/ML integration, big data platforms, and machine learning model training. As founder and principal architect of Reallexi LLC, I direct the architecture of a production AI product suite — private RAG memory systems, a local ML training platform with checkpoint-aware fine-tuning and artifact lineage, autonomous engineering agents, generative media pipelines, and a governed API gateway — owning each system end-to-end, from data pipeline to trained model to production inference. Alongside 15+ years architecting FinTech, SaaS, and enterprise platforms, including large-scale API and cloud modernization at First Citizens Bank and Silicon Valley Bank, I bring the same discipline to AI systems: scalable big-data pipelines, reproducible ML training, RAG and vector retrieval, and multi-agent orchestration, all delivered with the security, governance, and team mentorship that production AI demands.
main.contactmessage: Do not hesitate to contact me anytime

caseStudies.title: RealLexi / RealMemoryAI
caseStudies.tagline: Private, source-grounded company memory for AI agents
caseStudies.description: Directed the architecture of a tenant-isolated company-memory platform that turns documents, URLs, images, and email sources into governed AI context. Owns the full path from ingestion to grounded retrieval to scoped agent and API access, so answers stay traceable to approved sources instead of becoming an invisible permission layer.

caseStudies.title: AI Model Builder
caseStudies.tagline: Local ML training with checkpoint lineage and proof
caseStudies.role: Founder & ML Systems Architect, Reallexi LLC
caseStudies.description: Architected a local ML training platform that turns ambitious training targets into bounded, recoverable phases. Directed the design of the phased-training engine, checkpoint-aware recovery, and artifact lineage (LoRA adapters, standalone SafeTensors, GGUF) so every training run stays auditable and resumable, with a direct publishing path to the Hugging Face Hub.

caseStudies.title: AI Apply Pilot
caseStudies.tagline: Evidence-based job search, human-approved every step
caseStudies.description: Architected an AI job-search workspace that compares a candidate's resume against a job description, surfaces real alignment and gaps, and drafts evidence-linked resume updates for human review. Designed the product so AI assists analysis while every submission, approval, and edit stays under the candidate's control.

caseStudies.title: Real Memory AI Agent
caseStudies.tagline: A workspace-aware engineering agent, not a chat panel
caseStudies.description: Designed a VS Code engineering agent with Planner + Coder, Auto, Direct, and Single execution modes that inspects and edits the real workspace, runs commands and validation, and preserves session and project evidence — extended across Chrome, CLI, and MCP-assisted workflows.

caseStudies.title: RealLexi AI Studio
caseStudies.tagline: Privacy-aware AI image & video generation studio
caseStudies.description: Architected a creative studio for generating and editing AI images and video from reference media, with a review step before anything reaches the public gallery — built privacy-first, with generation pipelines routed across multiple model providers.

caseStudies.title: RLX Gate
caseStudies.tagline: A governed control plane for Envoy — no Kubernetes required
caseStudies.description: Architected a self-hostable API gateway that separates a Go-based control plane from the Envoy data plane, so traffic decisions are governed, signed, and auditable before they ever touch production. Supports OpenAPI import with malware scanning, weighted backends with health checks, and API key/JWT/OIDC identity, deployable on a single VPS without a Kubernetes dependency.

caseStudies.title: ApiDocPro
caseStudies.tagline: API documentation as a hosted, always-current service
caseStudies.description: Built a SaaS documentation engine that imports OpenAPI, Swagger, or GraphQL definitions and turns them into modern, branded, hosted docs — including the custom OpenAPI/AsyncAPI UI renderer at ui.apidocpro.com — so engineering, writing, and product teams stay aligned with the real implementation instead of hand-maintained docs.
